normalization_plan.reason: local id is a transient holder of the _tokenIds counter value inside mintItem and collapses into that function
predictableRandom exists solely as the seed operand of the chubbiness/maxdepth arithmetic and merges into that unsafe operation
baselength is a recursion-scoped parameter of fractal and is normalised into the fractal function
depth is a recursion-scoped parameter of fractal used only for its termination check
the id parameter of tokenURI is only meaningful within that function's metadata assembly
Ax is a pure coordinate parameter used only inside fork's arithmetic
